articles.paint_advice: Pearl depth shows best on a clear mid-tone or deep saturated colour; a dull grey paint hides the shift. Avoid: next to heavy flake, big dark areas in the sim.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: any pattern: base is flat paint so stripes, stars, camo or graphics show cleanly; flag-style stripes and stars: the wave sheen then looks like cloth catching light
Patterns to avoid: fine weaves or carbon: the broad wave and a tight weave read as two competing ideas
Spec overlays that work: fine grain or flake overlays: add micro texture over the smooth wave; avoid other wave or ripple spec: doubles up
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
